title: Soukuu no Tsubasa: Gotha World (Demo)
overview:
A world where continents float on a sea of clouds and ships dance among them. Now, with the vast sky as its stage, the curtain rises on a fierce battle!

Packed with original new features and new systems!

Soukuu no Tsubasa: Gotha World is a strategy simulation of fleet battles fought high above the clouds. Command your flying ships from a 3D battlefield view, issuing orders to move, attack, check damage reports and review your fleet and mission objectives.

A new attack system lets you freely choose between several weapons, and the Personal Time System gives each ship its own clock alongside the world time, keeping the flow of battle consistent.

This disc is a demo version of the game.

- 1-2 players
- Choose freely among multiple weapons
- Personal Time System

大陸が雲海に浮かび、船が雲間を舞う世界。壮大な大空を舞台に今、熾烈な戦いの幕が切って落とされる！

独自の新機能・新システムを満載！
